notes.title: [SPOILERS!] STATISTICS FROM THE FIRST FOUR MONTHS
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone, I hope you're doing well! ❤️[/b]

It’s been almost four months since I released my first game. This period has also been ideal for gathering enough data to share meaningful statistics with you. Whether knowingly or unknowingly, you contributed to several of these stats while playing the game. I’d like to share this information with you.

[b]Now, let's get started. Of course, the most important and most anticipated statistic: who did you choose?[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290316/759e845c5695d6083db0d0942a9669734886ac7a.png[/img]

[b]Secondly, another question many are curious about: How challenging was the game for you? Did you manage to overcome death?[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290316/604f6a9c84f721e6d2fa13197bf66e08a3e7b253.png[/img]

[b]But did you defy the monster and wait for the secret scene?[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290316/37d34bfbf93932cdd4469bdc170cfe1d3f794d71.png[/img]

[b]And finally... did you realize where you were all along?[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290316/c20e4e88cbd1e361b4ae94827d2484f8e2195c05.png[/img]

[b]One last thing... I want to share a basic but important out-of-game stat: whether players liked the game or not.[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45290316/f9eb140b7975ca2cd14547c553026012ce9fed72.png[/img]

And that’s it... these are the statistics I was able to gather and share with you. Thank you all so, so much for playing my game. This was my very first release, and if it managed to entertain you even a little, that means the world to me.

[b]Also, I’ve already started working on my second game![/b] I’ll be sharing updates with you in the near future, so make sure to follow the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45486407]Patchwork Interactive Curator Page[/url].

Thanks to your feedback, I believe I’ve been able to clean up nearly all the bugs over these four months. But if you encounter any bugs, feel free to reach out to me on X or via email. And if even that feels like too much work, feel free to just [url=https://steamcommunity.com/id/svklmrt]add me on Steam[/url] and shoot me a DM!

[b]Enjoy the game, and take care! ❤️[/b]

notes.title: Difficulty lowered due to recent negative reviews.
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm back with something different. 

Over the past few weeks, I noticed that nearly half of the reviews have been negative. To understand why, I went through each review one by one. As many of you pointed out, the "Weeping Angel" cycle towards the end of the game was frustratingly difficult for some players.

In response to this feedback, I have made the "grab the key from the bookshelf" task slightly easier.

Thank you all for your constructive reviews! If you encounter any bugs, feel free to reach out to me on X or via email.

[b]Enjoy the game, and take care![/b]

notes.title: More Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm back with more bug fixes. I'm trying to bring the current state of the game to the highest level possible.

- Fixed the girl running towards us as soon as she spawned in the loop where we had to collect keys.
- Flickering textures fixed.
- Some lighting issues fixed.
- Some sound issues fixed.

If you encounter any bugs or translation errors in the game, please feel free to contact me via X or email.

[b]Have fun![/b]

notes.title: Bugs fixed, menu has been adjusted, and the sound and lighting revised.
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

First of all, I am so sorry to everyone whose gameplay experience was affected by these bugs. I am developing the game on my own, so sometimes I can't keep up with everything. I truly appreciate your understanding.

- The bug that caused players to get stuck between the door and the wall has been fixed. 
- The game freeze at the left exit in the dark and long loop has been resolved. 
- Some sounds and lighting have been revised. 
- Warnings have been added to the menu. 

If you notice any other bugs or find any issues with the translations, please feel free to contact me via X or email. 

[b]Have fun![/b]
